columns: 0:480 joint q,v; 480:540 relative rotation6d; appended 540:570 ten root-frame reference XYZ when enabled; A4 appends measured (imagined for H32) minus reference hinge angle in radians
normalization: source frozen; XYZ zero mean, 0.05 m std fixed from declared translation scale, no held-out fit; A4 hinge 5 degree std
optimizer: AdamW, no decay, fixed lr, all Actor parameters
sampling: 64 nominal + 64 pooled eligible coverage; both halves nominal for A0/A1; fixed sampling generator
extra_labels: positive mask only; physical failed/phase-mismatched/intervened intervals retained in raw data
losses: four equally weighted physical unit blocks; as in contact calibration; no artificial history noise
